definitions.explanation: animal feces, used especially for animal droppings rather than human waste

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糞|ふん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けて→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please clean up the dog droppings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糞|ふん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肥料|ひりょう}→肥料：06102_hiryou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Horse dung is used as fertilizer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遊歩道|ゆうほどう}→遊歩道：23484_yuuhodou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糞|ふん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{落|お}ちていて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧、⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧にくかった。
examples.english: There were so many bird droppings on the park walkway that it was hard to walk.

notes:
Primarily used for animal excrement. The reading ふん is the standard neutral/scientific form. The same kanji can also be read ⟦くそ→くそ：10783_kuso⟧, which is vulgar and commonly used as a curse word. Signs in parks saying "⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糞|ふん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}りましょう→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧" (please take your dog's droppings home) are ubiquitous in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糞|ふん}: dog droppings
- ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糞|ふん}: bird droppings
- {糞|ふん}{尿|にょう}: excrement and urine
- {糞|ふん}⟦{害|がい}→害：02542_gai⟧: damage from droppings (e.g., pigeon droppings on buildings)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦くそ→くそ：10783_kuso⟧: shit/crap — same kanji ({糞|くそ}), but vulgar; also used as a curse or intensifier
- ⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧: stool — medical/clinical term for human feces
- ⟦{排泄物|はいせつぶつ}→排泄物：27658_haisetsubutsu⟧: excretion — formal term covering all bodily waste
- ⟦うんち→うんち：09084_unchi⟧: poop — childish, informal word used mainly by or with children
